title: 策略师谢毅哲：中国企业出海，海外收入占比仍低
speaker: Unnamed Guest

segments.en: People talk about the weak demand locally, domestically in China. So then people then talk about, okay well that's weak. You have a lot of these Chinese corporates going outside and building B-Y-D for example.
segments.zh: 人们谈论中国国内需求疲软。然后就说，好吧，那很弱。很多中国企业走出去，比如比亚迪。

segments.en: We just talked about that. Why hasn't that shown up in earnings or visions? Like I used EVs as an example.
segments.zh: 我们刚谈到这个。为什么这没有体现在盈利或展望中？我用电动车举例。

segments.en: So when even the leading companies, the percentage of earnings from overseas is just starting to moving up. We're talking about some of them are in the tens, 15% the leading ones I think close to 20%, 30%.
segments.zh: 即使是领先企业，海外收入占比才刚刚开始上升。有些在百分之十几，领先的接近20%、30%。

segments.en: So another the remaining 70 and 90, they're still under the pressure of margin. Let alone also the chip prices also moving up. So that could also tighten the margin further.
segments.zh: 所以剩下的70%到90%仍面临利润率压力。更不用说芯片价格也在上涨，这可能会进一步挤压利润率。

segments.en: So the evolution really affects these consumption sector. In a way when you think about the car, the EVs prices in China are so attractive compared to the international market.
segments.zh: 所以这种演变确实影响了消费行业。想想汽车，中国电动车价格相比国际市场非常有吸引力。

segments.en: But within China there is still because of the condition they're still pricing pressure for the EVs. So I think that's the reason that you gotta draw, you gotta draw the area but you gotta drag as well.
segments.zh: 但在中国国内，由于条件，电动车仍面临定价压力。所以我认为这就是原因，你既要看到机会也要看到拖累。

segments.en: So that's why if you look at the entire EV sector, it's not done well. Despite the fact that if you're coming in the second quarter result, I bet all the tension will be on the X-Watt growth.
segments.zh: 这就是为什么整个电动车板块表现不佳。尽管二季度业绩，我打赌所有关注点都在海外增长上。

segments.en: Oh, some of the companies just started to go overseas. Their numbers would look really nice.
segments.zh: 哦，一些公司刚刚开始出海。它们的数字会很好看。
